'''C-RD4''' was a [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|shopkeeper droid]] that served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] as a merchant in the [[Imperial Lodgement]] in the [[Minimum Security Section]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
C-RD4 appears as an Equipment Commendations Vendor for Imperial players on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
